book.name: Taalie
book.title: Ala xa Taalie Ala xa Taalie

content.text: N ma di, xa i i yɛtɛ taanixi i boore nde bɛ,
i findixi hamilu ra a bɛ e nun mixi gbɛtɛ tagi,
xa i i yɛtɛ raxɛtɛnxi i xa wɔyɛnyi nde ra,
xa i i yɛtɛ xirixi na laayidi mɔɔli ra,
n ma di, i xa fe birin naba i yɛtɛ raminide a kui,
xa na mu a ra i luma nɛ i boore sagoe.
Siga, i i felen i boore bɛ, i xa a mayandi.
I naxa xi de, na raba keren na.
I i yɛtɛ ratanga yi fe mɔɔli ma,
alɔ xeli a yɛtɛ ratangama koyinma bɛlɛxɛ ma ki naxɛ,
alɔ xɔni fan a yɛtɛ ratangama gantanyi ma ki naxɛ.
Tunnaxɔnɛ, siga dondoli yire.
Marasi fen a ra, alako i xa findi xaxilima ra.
Mangɛ mu na dondoli bɛ,
kuntigi nun yarerati fan mu a bɛ,
kɔnɔ a walima sogofure tɛmui,
alako a xa baloe sɔtɔ a naxan donma ɲɛmɛ ra.
I tan tunnaxɔnɛ, i i sama han mun tɛmui?
I kelima xixɔli ma tɛmui mundun?
Xixɔli na i suxu, i na kinsɔn, i na i sa,
setareɲa fan fama nɛ i suxude tɛrɛnna ra,
alɔ muɲɛti mixi tɛrɛnnama ki naxɛ.
Kaamɛ i suxuma nɛ, alɔ sɔɔri mixi suxuma ki naxɛ.
Fuyante mu tinxin, a wule raɲɛrɛma a dɛ i nɛ.
A luma a ya magira ra,
a nu mixi makebentin a sanyie nun a bɛlɛxɛe ra wule tɔnxuma ra.
Fe ɲaaxi na a xaxili kui,
a gere masoma tɛmui birin.
Na kui kasarɛ fama nɛ a suxude,
a a xun nakana kerenyi ra.
Fe senni na Alatala naxee xɔnxi,
a mu tinma nee ra fefe ma:
yɛtɛ igboe xa mixi mato ki,
wule minima dɛ naxan kui,
bɛlɛxɛ naxan nii bama fufafu ra,
bɔɲɛ naxan fe tinxintare maɲɔxunma,
sanyi naxee e gima sigafe ra fe kobi rabade,
seede naxan wule falama,
a nun mixi naxan ngaxakerenmae tagi isoma.
N ma di, i baba xa sɛriyɛ ragata,
i naxa tondi i nga xa marasi ra.
E xa lu i bɔɲɛ kui tɛmui birin, e xiri i kɔn ma.
E i raɲɛrɛma nɛ i xa duniɲɛigiri kui,
e i makanta i xa sade ma, e i rasi i keli tɛmui.
Na sɛriyɛ findixi lanpui nan na,
na xaranyi kira masenma nɛ i bɛ,
na marasi i xun tima simaya kira nan xɔn ma.
E i ratangama ginɛ kobi ma,
nun xɔɲɛ ginɛ dɛ iɲɔxunxi ma.
I naxa wa na ginɛ xɔn ma a xa tofanyi ma,
i naxa tin a xa nɔ i ra a yae ra.
Langoe ginɛ naxan mu na xɛmɛ taa, a mixi findima setare nan na,
kɔnɔ ginɛ yɛnɛla naxan dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ nde xɔn, a mixi faxama nɛ.
Mixi nde nɔma tɛ tongode, a a sa a yuba kui,
a fa lu a xa donma mu gan?
Mixi nde nɔma a ɲɛrɛde tɛ wole tagi,
a fa lu a sanyi mu gan?
Na maniyama nɛ alɔ xɛmɛ naxan yabuma ginɛ xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ ra.
Xɛmɛ yo din na ginɛ ra, a fama ɲaxankatɛ nan sɔtɔde.
Mixi mu yoma muɲɛti ma,
naxan muɲɛ tixi a xa kaamɛ ma,
kɔnɔ a na suxu fo a xa muɲafe sare fi,
hali na findi a xa naafuli birin na.
Kɔnɔ xaxilitare nan tun yɛnɛ rabama ginɛ ra.
A a xun nakana na fe mɔɔli ra.
A fe xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔma nɛ yaagi kui,
naxan mu gbilenma a fɔxɔ ra sɔnɔn,
barima tɔɔnɛ xɛmɛ bɔɲɛ ratema nɛ a ɲaaxi ra.
Ginɛ kanyi mu kinikinima a gbe ɲɔxɔɛ lɔxɔɛ.
A bɔɲɛ mu goroma kɔbiri ra.
Hali i a gbegbe fi a ma, a mu a rasuxuma.
